meta.title: Improve temp cleanup performance
meta.body_summary: Add async executor for temp file cleanup, replace Files.list with DirectoryStream, introduce configurable batching and pause settings.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR for temp cleanup async/batching; only bot review provided, no human engagement; closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 769 changed lines, this is a medium-sized refactor across 11 files. As a backend performance PR, it was closed without merge, likely due to lack of maintainer review or acceptance of the approach.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot noted that batch counter increments regardless of pause, and batchSize=0 with pauseMs>0 would not cause pauses, plus counter reset inside pause condition bug.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve temp cleanup performance through async exec and streaming

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Refactoring temp cleanup with async and DirectoryStream; closed without merge when no human engaged, despite bot identifying batching logic issues.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot provided inline suggestions on batching logic and queue capacity.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or performance measurement provided; PR relies on general claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No human review; PR closed without addressing bot comments.

core_change_summary.description: Replace Files.list with DirectoryStream in TempFileCleanupService, add async executor configuration with single-threaded pool, and introduce configurable batchSize and pauseBetweenBatchesMs settings.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Other file changes include UI/controller adjustments that may be unrelated to the core cleanup performance.
change_trajectory: Initial commit introduced async config, DirectoryStream, batching in cleanup service.
Subsequent commits added further adjustments, including DesktopBrowser.java updates.
Pixeebot made hardening suggestions in test file.
No human review; PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: Batch counter increments even if pause not triggered; batchSize=0 with pauseMs>0 will not pause.
Counter reset inside pauseMs condition; should reset regardless.
Queue capacity of 100 is a magic number; consider making it configurable.
Summarized PR changes and generated 3 inline comments.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with async/batching changes; Copilot bot reviewed immediately with three inline suggestions.
Author made several follow-up commits but no response to bot comments.
No human maintainer engaged; PR remained open for ~1 day and was then closed without merge.
